messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not float a medicine canister in water to see if it is empty"
set: ["do not float a medicine canister in water to see if it is empty", "do not puncture or burn an empty inhaler canister", "do not assume medicine is to blame", "replace your inhaler if it is washed or placed in water", "if stored in the refrigerator do not allow it to freeze", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not", "canister may explode if it gets too hot", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "do not let it freeze", "do not use if medicine looks cloudy, has changed colors, or has particles in it", "tests to determine if medicine is effective", "do not inject leftover medicine", "do not keep leftover medicine", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "do not divide the medicine in the capsule", "do not remove and reapply it"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
